evidence_scope: rtl_verified open-source Beacon and Yosys synthesis estimates; explicitly NOT physical Vivado FPGA timing, placed-and-routed bitstream utilization, or foundry ASIC sign-off.

target_fpga_device.board: AMD/Xilinx Alveo U55C (primary proposed target, unapproved ODR-004)

local_rv64_beacon_u55c_estimates.name: VX_tensor_top scaled RV64 2-core + 256 KiB L2 + WGMMA + DXA
local_rv64_beacon_u55c_estimates.configuration: USE_DSP=0, STD FPU, 16T/16W, SOCKET_SIZE=2, VX_CFG_TCU_MX_ENABLE, VX_CFG_PLATFORM_MEMORY_NUM_BANKS=1

gated_xlen32_beacon_logic_gate_results.measurement_note: 258,820 LUT (tensor) and 119,629 LUT (tcu) are the live 1cf68ff ci/logic_gate.py measurements compared against the checked-in baselines in ci/baselines/synthesis/beacon/tensor.json (260,189 LUT for tensor and 119,887 LUT for tcu).

academic_asap7_yosys_baselines.note: Separately scoped academic pre-layout ASAP7 Yosys 0.69 + OpenSTA 3.1.0 estimates (xlen=32, tt corner, 800 MHz target, black-box SRAM heuristic); NOT foundry sign-off or RV64 post-layout PPA.

limitations: All Beacon and Yosys figures are pre-implementation RTL synthesis/logic-level estimates, not physical Vivado FPGA place-and-route timing or measured hardware power/frequency.
Local RV64 Beacon U55C estimates exclude the Alveo U55C static/dynamic XRT shell, XDMA bridge, HBM AXI crossbar, and SLR crossings.
Checked-in ASAP7 Yosys baselines are XLEN=32 academic predictive estimates with black-box SRAM heuristics.
